screens.screen: home (businesses: address bar, offers swiper, sections, business list, 5-tab bottom nav)
business menu (categories, product cards, add-to-cart / options / quantity counter, confirm-order bar)
order details / tracking (status timeline, items, chat FAB, call-driver button)

notes: Colours (#f4333f primary, #00CA71 green, #f8f8f8 background), Cairo font, strings and icons (Material + CupertinoIcons font) are from the code. Offer banners, section covers, business covers/logos and product photos are network images in the app, so they are drawn as neutral gradients with a generic glyph or an initial; the banner text is sample content. The bottom-nav label is spelled 'الرئسية' in the code (typo for 'الرئيسية') and was kept as written. The address card in the app bar is drawn about 6px taller than the toolbar strictly allows so both text lines fit. Currency is the app's own format (#,##0 + ' ﷼'); sample data uses Sana'a, Yemen (the app's country list includes +967). Order-status row is shown scrolled to its end so the current step is visible.
